title: Prepared reader performance
summary: COMPLETE: six approved outcomes delivered with measured production gains and preserved reader behavior. Baseline cross-host typography assertion remains disclosed outside unchanged-visual scope. No new renderer or product treatment.

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved continuation focused on perceptible responsiveness and static/prepared rendering

verificationRecords.scope: Eight cohorts compared with prepared-baseline; static candidate rejected for payload growth and unchanged layout counts. Semantic/compiler tests, app types, architecture, build and primary smoke passed before removal.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:computed-style-clone; npm run visual:cancellation; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.scope: Color focus projection across three engines, focused division lifecycle canary, and architecture; diagnostic builds 53 to 25.
Twelve bidirectional cycles preserve visible glyph geometry and identity with four builds; resize, font invalidation and pagehide retire all owned layers. Smoke 41 and architecture/types passed.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:fractional-linear-equation -- --preparation --base-url=http://127.0.0.1:8000; npm run typecheck
verificationRecords.scope: Forced idle ownership, twelve reverse cycles, resize/font/disposal; full types; 41 cold/warm smoke; queue eight units; architecture and production build.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:browser:reader-conformance; npm run check:reader-budgets; npm run test:browser:native-katex-compositor-conformance:release
verificationRecords.scope: 17 reader cases, all 12 route budgets, six supported-browser compositor/lifecycle cases. Navigation and cancellation canaries corrected. Existing cross-host font parity assertion remains failing and documented.

Eight isolated production cohorts: normal CPU p95 about 17.6ms, scripting 45.8 to 64.1 percent lower, bounded retained preparation. Cold worst frames still up to 200.2ms under slowdown; complete costs recorded.

34 theme samples with exact current non-color paint and geometry; all inactive prepared glyphs have zero effective opacity. Final 41-point smoke, six cross-browser native preparation cases, node types and production exclusion also passed.

allowedWork: Precompiled reader instructions, preparation and paint lifecycle repairs, bounded reuse and prewarming, measured resource checks, existing regression reconciliation
disallowedWork: New visual treatment, universal renderer, worker rewrite, fixed SVG replacement, derivation-trail product UI, deployment or destructive Git operations
goal: Reduce visible preparation stalls with precompiled instructions and bounded valid reuse

slices.title: Static-publication
slices.summary: Baseline and static-publication experiment complete. Asset-only precompilation increased payload without meaningful traversal benefit and was removed; evidence identifies nominal publication constraints and prioritizes geometry reuse.

slices.title: Paint-and-geometry
slices.summary: Declared color-only focus refreshes inert material paint without invalidating geometry; interpolation remains native and bounded host scheduling cancels on retirement.

slices.title: Prepared-replay
slices.summary: Bounded exact-key transition reuse eliminates warm preparation builds; native endpoint parking and global measurement invalidation preserve paint ownership.

slices.title: Bounded-advance-preparation
slices.summary: One hidden neighbor may reuse complete preparation only after quiet and actual idle budget; cancellations and overrun stop guard speculation. Frozen hidden paint defect fixed and pressure tested.

slices.title: Reliability-and-loading
slices.summary: Repeated prepared paint, direct jumps, whole-layout invalidation, disposal and bounded resources checked. Local CSS leakage repaired; explicit publication cost amendments recorded. Existing typography parity issue remains outside unchanged-visual scope.

slices.title: Integration-and-evidence
slices.summary: Final production and preservation evidence integrated; roadmap and thread updated. Static experiment rejected honestly, measured gains and remaining cold preparation and broad invalidation recorded. Owned changes ready for final feature-branch backup.
